preserved: Real Hausdorff locally convex E and its continuous dual.
Every finite-dimensional observation subspace F, its finite-dimensional dual, and the exact fiber-infimum record.

Construct the maximal lower semicontinuous convex minorant from all finite records.

removed: The independent requirement to produce the continuous-affine dual formula.
changed_goal.reason: Maximality identifies the requested object and remains necessary. The affine-duality request prescribed a solution route and is not needed to specify that object.

necessary_main_goal_specs: The exact pointwise maximality among all lsc convex minorants.
The original space E, the record domains F*, all finite-dimensional F and the restriction maps.
Connection between the records and the constructed global function.
advance_solution_hints_removed: Continuous affine lower bounds as an explicitly requested dual route.
precise_minimal_completion_criterion: Give one valid record-based construction of G, prove 0 <= G <= f, lower semicontinuity, convexity and maximality, and prove the raw restriction/inf-projection relation with a mathematically correct link to the global reconstruction. A candidate need not state an affine dual formula, a biconjugate identity, the optional reclosure relation or any warning/counterexample.

shortest_valid_route.description: Take each record epigraph closure, form the supremum of its pullbacks, use continuous affine separation of the closed epigraph of f to prove maximality, and use fiber partition plus envelope maximality for record relations. An equally short correctly scoped Fenchel-Moreau proof is accepted.
shortest_valid_route.difficulty_caveat: Removing the duality recipe reduces hinting, but this remains a standard medium-length convex-analytic reconstruction. No long-chain or empirical-difficulty claim is established.
